messages.content: "Can you help me plan my day? I want to start from my home in New York and go to a chess club named 'Knight Gambit' located in Boston. I want to take the fastest route. After that, I want to go to another chess club named 'Rook Corner' in Philadelphia, again taking the fastest route. Finally, I want to return home, but this time I want to take the shortest route. Can you also provide me with the details of the events hosted by both chess clubs?"

function.description: Determines the best route between two points. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

1. Find details of 'Knight Gambit' in Boston. They want event info. Use chess_club_details_find(name="Knight Gambit", city="Boston").
2. Calculate fastest route from New York to Knight Gambit. Use route_planner_calculate_route(start="New York", destination="Boston", method="fastest").
3. Find details of 'Rook Corner' in Philadelphia. Use chess_club_details_find(name="Rook Corner", city="Philadelphia").
4. Calculate fastest route from Boston to Rook Corner. Use route_planner_calculate_route(start="Boston", destination="Philadelphia", method="fastest").
5. Calculate shortest route from Philadelphia back home. Use route_planner_calculate_route(start="Philadelphia", destination="New York", method="shortest").
